data.data:
Dear Endministrator,

Recruitment for Arknights: Endfield Beta Test II has officially started! You'll find the key info and FAQs for this test below:

Complete the recruitment survey for a chance to join Beta Test II.

Survey link: https://survey.gryphline.com/s/307f02139423c46f3fdb9fa69e3a1eda


▼// Recruitment Period

2025-10-31 (UTC-5) – End date to be announced


▼// Test Overview

Platforms: PC & Mobile (Android/iOS)

Test Type: Limited-access, free of charge, data-wipe test

Period: 2025-11-28 (UTC-5) – End date to be announced

Game Languages: Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, Spanish, Russian

Voice Languages: Mandarin, English, Japanese, Korean
